get.summary: Returns live statistics for the router instance (uptime, request counters, pool counts).
Exports current pools and aggregated pools as JSON snapshot.

post.summary: Creates and returns a set of unsigned Algorand transactions for the specified swap route.

generatedAt.description: UTC time when snapshot was generated.

pools.description: Collection of individual pools currently loaded.

aggregatedPools.description: Collection of aggregated pools currently loaded.

ExportSnapshot.description: Snapshot payload containing current pools and aggregated pools used for exporting/importing router state.

sender.description: Sender who will be signing the transactions

swapAmount.description: Amount to swap in base units of asset FromAsset

receiveMinimum.description: Minimum amount to receive in base units of asset ToAsset

routesCount.description: Specifies the number of routes to calculate. The default value is 1.

maxHops.description: Maximum hops to use in route calculation. The default value is 3.

route.description: If specified, it will not calculate routes but will use the provided route as the only route to execute.

oneOf.description: Allows to define transaction parameters so that they do not have to be fetched from the network at calculation time.

txsToSign.description: Txs to sign in base64 format and byte array in msgpack format

oneOf.description: Transaction parameters from input or fetched from network

instanceId.description: Unique identifier of the router service instance (generated at startup).

startTime.description: UTC timestamp when the router instance started.

uptimeSeconds.description: Elapsed uptime in seconds since DateTimeOffset RouterStats.StartTime.

poolsCount.description: Current number of individual pools loaded in memory.

aggregatedPoolsCount.description: Current number of aggregated pools (asset pair liquidity aggregations).

quoteRequests.description: Total count of quote (simple amount) requests served.

routeRequests.description: Total count of detailed route requests served.

totalQuotedInput.description: Sum of all input amounts quoted (base units).

totalQuotedOutput.description: Sum of all output amounts produced for quotes (base units).

fallbackHops.description: Number of hop executions that fell back to aggregated pool estimation due to missing real pools.

routesWithFallback.description: Number of routes where at least one hop used aggregated fallback.

averageHopsPerRoute.description: Average number of hops per completed route request.

poolUpdates.description: Number of pool updates received from Redis pubsub.

aggregatedPoolUpdates.description: Number of aggregated pool updates received from Redis pubsub.

RouterStats.description: Runtime statistics snapshot for a single router service instance since last restart.
